_note_1071_stall_retired: 1071 Meowth ex — `stall` was RETIRED here on 2026-07-03 (developer sign-off; re-model recorded in src/agents/mega_lucario/STRATEGY.md §3: `['search','stall']` -> `['search','supporter_tutor']`). Do NOT restore it. `stall` is a play-role meaning "a big-HP wall piloted not to attack"; Meowth ex is the opposite — HP 170 for TWO prizes, and Last-Ditch Catch is a once-only ON-PLAY-FROM-HAND Supporter search, so once played the body's value is SPENT. Its only attack is Tuck Tail {C}{C}{C} for 60, and the standing doctrine is "never attach energy to Meowth unless desperate". The replacement tag `supporter_tutor` carries the real function. This entry exists because the 2026-07-03 re-model edited the SHIPPED table (src/common/card_functions.json) but left `stall` here, and this file is a standing INSTRUCTION to the builder, not a record — classify_functions unions it in on every build (`--fresh` included, since the union sits upstream of the accumulate step `--fresh` skips), so the stale tag was a pending re-introduction. Reconciliation is now asserted: tests/cards/test_card_functions_oracle.py, REQ-FUNC-0016 (Issue #375).
_note_team_rocket: TEAM ROCKET FAMILY (Issue #374, POC-A2.1) — `team_rocket` marks the 52 Pokemon whose PRINTED NAME carries the "Team Rocket's" owner prefix, re-derived from tools/meta_tracker/cards.json (the engine's own all_card_data dump) rather than recalled. It is the build-time family index over the pool that Issue #301 recorded as MISSING, which is why nine cards' membership tests could only be `partial`: 15 Team Rocket's Energy (attach-legal only to one), 414 Articuno, 431 Mewtwo ex (can't attack under 4 in play), 436 Orbeetle, 1154 Hypnotizer, 1216 Ariana, 1217 Archer, 1218 Giovanni, 1220 Proton. The gap is NARROWER than 'nothing could answer it', and the narrower claim is the true one: for a body already IN PLAY the question is free — the dump carries `name`, CardStat.name holds it, and provider.applies_to_holder already answers it through card_text.name_in_family. What has no answer is the HIDDEN-DECK half (1220 Proton's 'Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Team Rocket's Pokemon'), which needs an index over the POOL rather than a test against one visible name. No STRUCTURAL field supplies that — the dump carries stage/ex/megaEx/tera/aceSpec/evolvesFrom/energy and nothing naming the family, and the 52 spread across 8 different energy types, so this is the same shape as Issue #349's ANCIENT / FUTURE finding. DELIBERATELY NOT TAGGED, per 'no silent caps': 1256 Team Rocket's Watchtower is a red herring — despite the name its text is "{C} Pokemon in play (both yours and your opponent's) have no Abilities", which runs no membership test at all. 1257 Team Rocket's Factory and 1134 Team Rocket's Transceiver run a DIFFERENT test — substring "Team Rocket" over SUPPORTER NAMES, not owner-family membership over Pokemon — and the developer ruled the stadium out of scope; 1134 keeps its printed literal in card_effects.json. The tag is inert today (no consumer whitelist names it), which is the authored-ahead-of-its-consumer case snapshot_coverage.UNCONSUMED_SELECTORS ledgers one axis over. Beware a NAME collision that is not a functional one: EnergyType.TEAM_ROCKET (11) in src/cg/api.py is the special ENERGY card's type, not a Pokemon trait.
